text: Central bank leaders from major economies issue a joint statement supporting the Federal Reserve and its chair. The declaration reinforces cross-border institutional norms of monetary independence while underscoring visible tension between central banking authority and executive pressure in the United States.

meta.note: Statement is symbolic and declarative; no operational or legal intervention accompanies the support.

text: Delta forecasts earnings growth driven by premium level demand, with seat expansion concentrated in higher-end cabins. Revenue mix shifts as premium ticket sales overtake main cabin growth, reinforcing a bifurcated demand structure while overall capacity remains constrained.

meta.note: Forecast-based disclosure; demand durability outside premium segment remains uncertain.

text: JPMorgan Chase reports quarterly results above expectations as equities and fixed-income trading revenues exceed forecasts. A pre-announced reserve tied to the Apple Card portfolio weighs on net income but does not disrupt overall revenue growth or operating stability.

meta.note: Trading-driven upside contrasts with weaker investment banking fees within the same reporting period.
